title: Lucid’s smaller Cosmos SUV, slated for 2026, has been pushed back to 2027
summary: Lucid’s upcoming “mid-size” Cosmos SUV, which it had said would come out later this year, will now not launch until at least 2027.

title: EVgo is putting 500+ fast chargers where Americans shop
summary: EVgo is adding more than 500 DC fast-charging stalls at shopping centers across the US, giving drivers more places to charge while they buy groceries, grab lunch, or run errands.

title: Chevy Blazer EV prices remain the same for 2027 despite a few upgrades
summary: The 2027 Chevy Blazer EV is the same price as the outgoing model, despite gaining a NACS port and additional features.

title: Toyota announces 2027 bZ prices start at $35,000
summary: The 2027 Toyota bZ will begin arriving at dealerships in September, starting at $34,980.

title: New Porsche boss says electric 718 is still coming, Taycan isn’t going anywhere
summary: Porsche has recently gone back and forth on electrification, but its new CEO Michael Leiters said in his first major interview that the electric 718 model will be built, after much speculation otherwise. But there are still inklings that he’s not as committed to electrification as he could be.

title: Hyundai confirms the IONIQ 6 N is still on track to launch in the US soon
summary: Hyundai shut down rumors that the IONIQ 6 N has been canceled for the US. The IONIQ 6 N is still on track to launch by the end of 2026.

title: Subaru’s new Trailseeker EV is already outselling its other electric vehicles
summary: The Trailseeker is already outselling the Solterra and Subaru’s other electric vehicles just months after its launch.

title: Europe is betting big on a battery that runs for four days
summary: Long-duration energy storage startup Ore Energy has landed what it says is the largest iron-air battery deal in continental Europe so far – and now it’s raised Series A funding. [update]

title: Waymo CEO explains why Tesla’s camera-only self-driving falls short
summary:
Waymo co-CEO Dmitri Dolgov laid out the clearest technical case yet for why cameras alone can’t take a self-driving system to full autonomy, arguing that “weak sensing” hits a safety ceiling long before it reaches superhuman performance.

He never said the word Tesla. But camera-only is Tesla’s entire bet, and this was a direct shot at it.

title: Tesla China sales are crashing as exports surge
summary:
Tesla’s sales inside China fell 19% in the first half of 2026 compared to its peak in 2023, dropping to the lowest level in years, according to new data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA).

At the same time, exports out of Giga Shanghai surged 127%. Tesla’s China plant is increasingly building cars to ship somewhere else.

title: Audi’s cheapest EV is also its most efficient car of all time
summary: Audi is reviving the A2 name for its new entry-level electric vehicle. With its debut just around the corner, Audi revealed a few more details about the new ultra-efficient EV.

title: Segway’s new MAX G3 Plus electric scooter goes farther with more power and better safety
summary: Segway is giving its flagship commuter scooter a big upgrade with the launch of the new MAX G3 Plus, adding a larger battery, improved safety features, and what the company says is a more honest way of measuring range.

title: Revoy hybrid tandem trailer rolls towards reality with $27 million raise
summary: By packing batteries and an electric drive axle into a tandem trailer that fits between a conventional semi truck and trailer, Revoy EV promises to “electrify” trucking and cut a fleet’s fuel bill in half. Now, after years of development, the concept is taking some real steps towards production. In fact, it’s taking 27 million of them!

title: Geely Galaxy Battleship 700 tri-motor stuffs 1,113 hp in a high-luxe, boxy package
summary: The eagerly anticipated Geely Galaxy 700 was expected to be the Chinese brand’s answer to the Range Rover and Land Cruiser – but, with a tire-shredding 1,113 hp on tap, it may be a bigger, boxier answer to Italian exotic cars, instead!

title: This solar-powered ‘ambulance’ has a range of up to 444 miles
summary: A team of 23 Dutch university students has built a solar-powered “ambulance” designed to bring healthcare to places where fuel, electricity, and passable roads are all scarce.

title: BYD opens Denza Z9S pre-orders, claiming the ‘world’s longest’ EV range at 1,100 km
summary: BYD opened pre-orders for the new Denza Z9S in China, touting what it calls “the world’s longest pure electric range” of 1,100 km (683 mi), with prices starting under $50,000.

title: Base Power raises $1B to roll out its giant new home battery
summary: Base Power has just unveiled Core, a supersized 39.2-kWh home battery that it says can keep a house running for up to 36 hours and be installed in under an hour.

title: Hyundai is about to launch the IONIQ 3, and it plans to sell over 40,000 in 2027
summary: Hyundai is preparing to open orders for the IONIQ 3 throughout the second half of 2026. With mass production set to begin in Mid-August, Hyundai plans to sell over 40,000 next year.

title: Tesla FSD v14 Lite tied to rising HW3 computer failures, owners report
summary:
A growing number of Tesla owners running the new Full Self-Driving v14 “Lite” build on Hardware 3 (HW3) vehicles are reporting Autopilot computer overheating alerts — and, in some cases, outright computer failures.

The reports have stacked up in the two weeks since Tesla pushed v14 Lite to wide release, and four owners have contacted Electrek directly about the same problem.

title: Volvo’s next electric SUV will start in the upper $40,000 range
summary: Volvo is preparing to launch the EX50 in the US, an entry-level electric SUV aimed at the Tesla Model Y that will start at under $50,000.

title: Tesla Model Y RWD 2026 Review: an entry-level trim with top-of-the-line technology
summary:
I drove the 2026 Model Y RWD (Standard) for about 550 km (342 miles) across a mix of highway, back roads, and city driving, and I enjoyed the efficiency and technology far more than the driving experience itself. For anyone shopping for an affordable Tesla built around the brand’s software and ecosystem, this standard trim is a real contender, but it drives more like a generic SUV than the brand promises.

title: Tesla Supercharger shooting sparks EV charging safety debate
summary:
After a gunman opened fire at a Twin Falls, Idaho, In-N-Out with an attached Tesla Supercharger last week, EV owners flooded social media with the same suggestion: buy an EVject.

The breakaway charging connector lets you drive off while still plugged in. It sounds like an obvious fix for a horrifying scenario — but it’s a controversial device that doesn’t actually solve the problem, and it points to something Tesla and every other automaker should be building instead.

title: Hyundai and Kia’s record US sales run is showing no signs of slowing down
summary: Hyundai and Kia’s record sales streak in the US continued in July with electrified vehicles driving growth.

title: Aniioki’s latest 6,000W dual-motor e-bike blurs past the line so much it’s basically an electric motorcycle
summary:
If there’s one trend that has defined the direct-to-consumer e-bike industry over the last few years, it’s the relentless race toward bigger numbers. Bigger batteries. Bigger motors. Higher top speeds. And now Aniioki has unveiled what may be one of the most extreme examples yet.

The company’s new A9 Pro Max Dual Motor 2.0 arrives with up to 6,000 watts of peak motor power, a claimed top speed of well above 50 mph (80 km/h) depending on the version, and battery options topping out at a staggering 5 kWh. Those numbers go beyond just big e-bike figures and pass well into legitimate electric motorcycle numbers.

title: Argentina’s solar train brings zero-emission travel to an ancient trade route
summary: The Tren Solar de la Quebrada is Latin America’s first primarily solar-powered passenger train, carrying tens of thousands of travelers through the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Quebrada de Humahuaca with the power of the sun.

Through thousands of miles of riding, I’ve been fortunate to learn these e-bikes inside and out, top to bottom and front to back. title: Lectric eBikes hits $1 billion in sales, surpasses 750,000 e-bikes
summary: The largest electric bicycle company in the US, Lectric eBikes, has just hit a pair of dizzying milestones. The much-vaunted e-bike maker reached $1 billion in sales on its e-commerce platform yesterday and sold its 750,000th electric bicycle. And perhaps even more stunning, it landed those two feats on the same day.

title: This all-electric VinFast taxi service just debuted in Europe
summary: Vietnamese all-electric taxi operator Green SM has made its European debut in Copenhagen, rolling out a company-owned fleet of VinFast EVs.
